facts.statement: There are 15 machine part cards that are not the Doom Core.

facts.statement: There are 18 distinct card faces in total.
facts.sourceSentence: **18 distinct faces total.**

facts.statement: Position 1 on a machine part card is always the yellow HP die slot.
facts.sourceSentence: Position 1 is always the **yellow HP die slot**

facts.statement: Positions 2–5 on a machine part card hold icons, blanks, or dead spaces.
facts.sourceSentence: Positions 2–5 hold icons, blanks, or dead spaces.

facts.statement: The order of travel on a machine part card is 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5.
facts.sourceSentence: Order of travel = 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5.

facts.statement: An icon space is a live space with an effect badge connected to neighbours by a yellow connector bar.
facts.sourceSentence: **Icon space** — a live space with an effect badge. Connected to its neighbours by a YELLOW connector bar.

facts.statement: A blank space is a live space with plain dark-teal color and no icon, and no effect fires when landing on it.
facts.sourceSentence: **Blank space** — a live space, plain dark-teal, no icon (no effect fires).

facts.statement: Blank spaces are connected by yellow connector bars.
facts.sourceSentence: Also YELLOW-connected.

facts.statement: A dead space is a darkened, diagonally-hatched square.
facts.sourceSentence: **Dead space** — a DARKENED, diagonally-HATCHED square.

facts.statement: Dead spaces are connected by dull grey/teal bars, not yellow.
facts.sourceSentence: Connected by dull grey/teal bars, not yellow.

facts.statement: Landing on a dead space sends the die back to position 1.
facts.sourceSentence: Per the rulebook (`02-machine-phase.md`), landing on a dead space sends the die back to position 1.

facts.statement: Every card carries exactly one roll-condition tile.
facts.sourceSentence: Every card carries exactly ONE roll-condition tile.

facts.statement: No card in cards.pdf has multiple roll-condition tiles.
facts.sourceSentence: No card in cards.pdf has multiple roll-condition tiles.
